relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Thirteen (38%) of 34 participants developed migraine aura after CGRP infusion.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: In addition, 24 (71%) of 34 participants developed migraine headache following CGRP infusion.

key_findings: Intravenous CGRP infusion induced migraine aura in 38% and migraine headache in 71% of 34 patients with migraine with aura (open-label).
